sql_profile.sql: SELECT evidence_id FROM relationship_evidence WHERE relationship_id=? ORDER BY evidence_id LIMIT 100

SELECT oe.*,e.canonical_key,e.entity_type,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.source_entity_id) FROM relationships r WHERE r.target_entity_id=oe.target_entity_id) corpus_sites FROM operation_edges oe JOIN entities e ON e.id=oe.target_entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=? AND oe.evidence_ids<>'[]' ORDER BY oe.relationship_id LIMIT 2000

SELECT DISTINCT r.* FROM operation_entities oe JOIN relationships r ON (r.source_entity_id=oe.entity_id OR r.target_entity_id=oe.entity_id)
 WHERE oe.operation_id=? AND (oe.association IN ('proposed','confirmed_shared_evidence') OR (oe.association='context' AND oe.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM entities WHERE entity_type IN ('wallet','transaction')))) AND r.id>? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operation_entities ex WHERE ex.operation_id=? AND ex.association='excluded' AND ex.entity_id IN (r.source_entity_id,r.target_entity_id)) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT ?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category IN ('infrastructure_context','template_similarity') THEN independence_key END) weak,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category NOT IN ('infrastructure_context','template_similarity') THEN independence_key END) strong FROM operation_edges WHERE operation_id=? AND evidence_ids<>'[]' AND (source_entity_id=? OR target_entity_id=?)
SELECT id FROM adaptive_tests WHERE scope_kind=? AND scope_id=? AND status IN ('finished','failed') AND gap_keys LIKE ? AND finished_at>=? ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.target_entity_id,e.canonical_key,r.relationship_type FROM relationships r JOIN entities e ON e.id=r.target_entity_id WHERE r.investigation_id=? AND e.entity_type='site' LIMIT 20
SELECT record_kind,before_state,after_state,evidence_ids,reason,at FROM scientific_history WHERE operation_id=? ORDER BY at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT test_id,dimension,reserved,consumed,measured FROM adaptive_costs WHERE test_id IN (SELECT id FROM adaptive_tests WHERE status IN ('finished','failed') AND attributed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 600)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) n,SUM(CASE WHEN c.dimension IN ('http','dns','certificate','rdap') THEN c.consumed ELSE 0 END) requests FROM adaptive_tests t JOIN adaptive_costs c ON c.test_id=t.id WHERE t.status IN ('finished','failed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adaptive_costs c2 WHERE c2.test_id=t.id AND c2.dimension IN ('http','dns','certificate','rdap') AND c2.measured=0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adaptive_costs c3 WHERE c3.test_id=t.id AND c3.dimension='http')
SELECT id,family,finished_at,outcome FROM adaptive_tests WHERE status IN ('finished','failed') AND attributed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 600

SELECT test_id,outcome_kind,SUM(credit) credit FROM adaptive_outcomes WHERE test_id IN (SELECT id FROM adaptive_tests WHERE status IN ('finished','failed') AND attributed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 600) GROUP BY test_id,outcome_kind
SELECT kind,record_key,content_hash FROM operation_history WHERE operation_id=? ORDER BY at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_entities WHERE operation_id=? AND association<>'excluded') entities,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oe.independence_key) FROM operation_edges oe WHERE oe.operation_id=? AND oe.evidence_ids<>'[]' AND oe.category NOT IN ('infrastructure_context','template_similarity') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM operation_entities ex WHERE ex.operation_id=oe.operation_id AND ex.association='excluded' AND ex.entity_id IN (oe.source_entity_id,oe.target_entity_id))) independent_relationships,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_hypotheses WHERE operation_id=?) hypotheses,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_contradictions WHERE operation_id=? AND status='open') contradictions
SELECT DISTINCT e.* FROM evidence e JOIN operation_entities oe ON oe.entity_id=e.entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=? AND oe.association<>'excluded' ORDER BY e.captured_at DESC,e.id LIMIT 1200

SELECT t.*,h.fingerprint,h.id hunt_row,o.seed,o.external_id,o.investigation_id op_investigation FROM adaptive_tests t JOIN hunter_operations o ON o.id=t.scope_id LEFT JOIN operation_hunts h ON h.id=t.hunt_id WHERE t.scope_kind='operation' AND (t.status='reserved' OR (t.status='running' AND h.status='reserved')) AND t.scope_id=? ORDER BY t.created_at LIMIT 10

SELECT o.outcome_kind,SUM(o.credit) credit FROM adaptive_outcomes o JOIN adaptive_tests t ON t.id=o.test_id WHERE t.status IN ('finished','failed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adaptive_costs c2 WHERE c2.test_id=t.id AND c2.dimension IN ('http','dns','certificate','rdap') AND c2.measured=0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adaptive_costs c3 WHERE c3.test_id=t.id AND c3.dimension='http') GROUP BY o.outcome_kind
SELECT * FROM scientific_observations WHERE operation_id=? ORDER BY captured_at DESC,evidence_id LIMIT 1200
SELECT e.id,e.created_at,e.updated_at,m.why FROM hunter_operation_members m JOIN entities e ON e.entity_type=m.entity_type AND e.canonical_key=m.canonical_key WHERE m.operation_id=?
SELECT * FROM adaptive_tests WHERE scope_kind='operation' AND attributed_at IS NOT NULL AND budget_checked=0 AND hunt_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY finished_at LIMIT 20

SELECT c.*,o.evidence_id,o.domain,o.last_seen captured_at FROM wallet_candidates c JOIN wallet_observations o ON o.candidate_id=c.id WHERE c.validation_status='valid' AND c.best_context='deposit' AND c.investigation_id IN (SELECT ie.investigation_id FROM investigation_entities ie JOIN operation_entities oe ON oe.entity_id=ie.entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=? AND oe.association<>'excluded') ORDER BY o.last_seen DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT category,COUNT(DISTINCT independence_key) n FROM operation_edges oe WHERE operation_id=? AND evidence_ids<>'[]' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM operation_entities ex WHERE ex.operation_id=oe.operation_id AND ex.association='excluded' AND ex.entity_id IN (oe.source_entity_id,oe.target_entity_id)) GROUP BY category
SELECT * FROM scientific_hypotheses WHERE operation_id=? AND status='REJECTED'

SELECT
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_entities oe JOIN entities e ON e.id=oe.entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=?1 AND oe.association<>'excluded' AND e.entity_type='site') sites,
   (SELECT COUNT(*)||':'||COALESCE(MAX(c.updated_at),'') FROM wallet_candidates c WHERE c.investigation_id IN (SELECT ie.investigation_id FROM operation_entities oe JOIN investigation_entities ie ON ie.entity_id=oe.entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=?1 AND oe.association<>'excluded')) wallets,
   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT independence_key) FROM operation_edges WHERE operation_id=?1 AND evidence_ids<>'[]') evidence_units,
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_contradictions WHERE operation_id=?1 AND status='open') contradictions,
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_history WHERE operation_id=?1 AND kind='possible_deployment_wave') waves,
   (SELECT revision FROM hunter_operations WHERE id=?1) hunter_revision,
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM director_provider_health WHERE state='healthy') provider_healthy,
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM human_checkpoints h WHERE h.status<>'open' AND h.investigation_id IN (SELECT ie.investigation_id FROM operation_entities oe JOIN investigation_entities ie ON ie.entity_id=oe.entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=?1)) human_resolved,
   (SELECT st.max_hunts-st.hunts+COALESCE((SELECT bonus FROM adaptive_scope_state WHERE scope_kind='operation' AND scope_id=?1),0) FROM operation_state st WHERE st.operation_id=?1) budget,
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adaptive_tests WHERE scope_kind='operation' AND scope_id=?1 AND status IN ('finished','failed')) finished_tests,
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence WHERE investigation_id IN (SELECT ie.investigation_id FROM operation_entities oe JOIN investigation_entities ie ON ie.entity_id=oe.entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=?1 AND oe.association<>'excluded')) evidence_rows
SELECT claim,status,reason FROM scientific_contradictions WHERE operation_id=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT e.id,(SELECT ie.investigation_id FROM investigation_entities ie WHERE ie.entity_id=e.id ORDER BY ie.rowid LIMIT 1) inv FROM entities e WHERE e.entity_type='site' AND e.canonical_key=?

SELECT c.dimension,SUM(c.reserved) reserved,SUM(CASE WHEN c.measured=1 THEN c.consumed END) consumed,SUM(c.measured) measured_n,COUNT(*) n FROM adaptive_costs c JOIN adaptive_tests t ON t.id=c.test_id  GROUP BY c.dimension

SELECT oe.entity_id,e.canonical_key FROM operation_entities oe JOIN entities e ON e.id=oe.entity_id WHERE oe.operation_id=? AND e.entity_type='site' AND oe.association<>'excluded' ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 60
SELECT * FROM scientific_hypotheses WHERE operation_id=? AND set_key=? AND hypothesis_key=?
SELECT 1 x FROM human_checkpoints WHERE investigation_id=? AND status='open' LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 x FROM work_items WHERE target_key=? AND status IN ('queued','running','deferred') AND kind IN ('investigate_candidate','revisit_incomplete','revisit_changed_site') LIMIT 1
